Concern over faulty design of underpass 
 
SHRI RAM CHANDER JANGRA (Haryana): Sir, I want to bring a very important 
matter to the notice of the House through you. 
Sir, since 2014, when the government has been formed at the Centre under the 
leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, a new revolution has come in the 
development of the country's infrastructure. Whether it is the construction of national 
highways, expansion of railway network or the increase in air travel and airports, our 
country has made unprecedented progress under the leadership of Modi ji. Sir, every 
Indian has got immense facilities in every field in terms of transportation after 2014, 
but due to the highways and railways passing through rural areas, the villagers are 
facing some difficulties. I want to bring this to the notice of the government through 
you. 
Sir, the design of underpasses built to pass under national highways and 
railway lines is not right in many places. They are either very deep, where water gets 
filled during rainy days, some have water filled underground for 12 months, due to 
which the villagers have to take a long detour to come and go. Some are so narrow 
that the tractor trolleys used by farmers today cannot pass through them. This causes 
a lot of difficulties to the farmers. 
Sir, through you I request the government to pay attention to the improvement 
of the design of underpasses and those which are not correct, should be improved.
